$comment: Cross-language GRAPH conformance corpus (esm-libraries-spec §4.8). GENERATED by scripts/generate-graph-corpus.mjs from the TypeScript oracle — do not hand-edit. Pins the SEMANTIC graph model (component nodes/types/counts, coupling edges/types/labels, variable nodes/kinds/units/systems, dependency edges/relationships/equation_index, and the adjacency closure) plus the JSON adjacency-list export. Node and edge ORDER is not a conformance property — compare as multisets. The DOT and Mermaid byte formats are NOT pinned; see README.md for why.

files.name: minimal_chemistry
files.covers: reaction system + model + operator_compose, and a data_sources entry that must contribute NO node (spec §4.8.1)

files.name: full_coupled
files.covers: TWO data_sources entries (still no nodes) and a `callback` coupling, which names no two components and so contributes no edge

files.name: data_sources_only
files.covers: a document that is NOTHING BUT data_sources — both graphs must come back empty

files.name: expr_graphs_variable_deps
files.covers: a variable-dependency model (states, observeds, parameters) beside a reaction system, joined by a variable_map

files.name: scoped_refs_coupling
files.covers: nested `subsystems` (the expression graph must recurse into them), a `couple` entry, a `callback`, and a variable_map whose two endpoints share one component (a self-edge)

files.name: wildfire_atmosphere_ocean
files.covers: five models joined by seven variable_map couplings — the coupled multi-model document

files.name: model_only
files.covers: three models with no reaction system, plus data_sources and an operator_compose

files.name: reaction_system_only
files.covers: a document with only reaction systems — no model nodes at all

files.name: events_all_types
files.covers: an `event` coupling (contributes no component edge) alongside operator_compose and variable_map

targets.name: model_from_minimal_chemistry
targets.covers: a Model target — bare (unscoped) node names, `_var` placeholder equations

targets.name: reaction_system_from_minimal_chemistry
targets.covers: a ReactionSystem target — the spec §4.8.2 worked example

targets.name: model_with_subsystems
targets.covers: a Model target that itself has `subsystems` — recursion under a bare target

reference.notes: Atmospheric chemistry model with gas-phase and aerosol processes

targets.name: equation_ode
targets.covers: an Equation target with a derivative LHS and a self-reference on the RHS

targets.name: equation_observed
targets.covers: an Equation target with a bare-variable LHS

targets.name: reaction_bimolecular
targets.covers: a Reaction target — rate edges to every substrate AND product, plus stoichiometric edges

targets.name: expression_scalar
targets.covers: a bare Expr target — every free variable feeds the synthetic `expr_result` node
